extraction.name: Video-As-Prompt: Unified Semantic Control for Video Generation
extraction.description: A paper introducing Video-As-Prompt (VAP), a unified framework for semantic-controlled video generation using reference videos as prompts, and VAP-Data, a paired dataset of over 100K samples across 100 semantic conditions.
extraction.creator: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, Qiang Xu
extraction.publisher: ByteDance; The Chinese University of Hong Kong
extraction.rai:dataCollection: We curated thousands of high-quality real images from the Internet, then used Image-to-Video visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs to create paired videos by matching each image to compatible templates. The dataset was curated across 100 semantic conditions and over 100K paired samples.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Web Scraping, Manual Human Curator, Software Collection
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Thousands of high-quality real images from the Internet; commercial model templates from VIDU and Kling; community LoRAs.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Paired videos were created by matching each collected image to compatible Image-to-Video templates and generating video pairs using commercial model templates and community LoRAs.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: High-quality reference images were curated before pairing; the paper does not describe additional preprocessing beyond matching images to compatible templates.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The paper does not describe human annotation of labels; semantic conditions were organized into categories and paired samples were created using templates and LoRAs.
extraction.rai:machineAnnotationTools: Commercial APIs/templates from VIDU and Kling; community LoRAs; Gemini-2.5-pro and GPT-5 were used for automatic semantic-alignment scoring in evaluation, not dataset annotation.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: The dataset includes reference images spanning men, women, children, animals, objects, landscapes, and multi-subject cases; the paper also mentions semantics such as gender swap and age-related concepts, but does not state that sensitive attributes were explicitly collected as metadata.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The paper states intended use is research, education, and creative prototyping. It warns against misuse such as identity impersonation, deepfakes, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, surveillance, and generation of sexualized or violent media.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset is synthetic and derived from other generative models, so it may inherit stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations of the source templates.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The semantic conditions in VAP-Data are relatively limited, synthetic, and derived from other generative models; performance can degrade when caption semantics are inaccurate or when subject structure differs greatly; multiple reference videos can cause unwanted visual leakage. The authors also note that larger-scale real semantic-controlled video data is left for future work.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Research-only semantic-controlled video generation for research, education, and creative prototyping; supports training and evaluation of unified semantic-controlled video generation models, including zero-shot generation and downstream applications.
